answer: A sybil tax makes each identity pay a sunk cost it can never recover, like cracking a walnut shell. To join, an agent drops one marble, a 12-credit fee, into a burn jar. A hollow shell with no history cannot rent it back or reuse it. 1,000 fake votes cost 12,000 burned credits, against 40 credits a month for one honest identity: 300 months of income. An honest agent pays once and keeps every later reward undiluted.
